messages:
aria: Starting staged rollout for `serve-inference` -> v2026.03.21. Plan: canary 2% for 30m, then 10% for 30m, then 50% after ops signoff. Change window 03/21 22:00-23:00 PST. Release notes: https://intranet.redwood/release/serve-inference/v2026-03-21 :rocket:

deploy-bot: CI passed. Rollout started (id=roll-8234). Canary at 2% across ap-south + eu-west initial zones.

kai: @aria confirm `--kvcache-warmup=enabled`? last time cold KV spiked tail.

aria: yes enabled. watching tail.

opsbot: Telemetry: eu-west p95 +15ms vs baseline, 5xx 0.08% (baseline 0.03%). No user-facing errors yet.

marta: :eyes: small but nonzero. propose hold at 2% extra 15m to let KV settle.

samir: kicking synthetic warmup: `/ops warmup --service serve-inference --targets canary --duration 3m`

opsbot: Warmup started by samir. 50r/s for 3m.

opsbot: Warmup complete. eu-west p95 now +4ms, 5xx 0.03%.

marta: good. one more interval before advance.

aria: holding 10m more then auto-advance unless HOLD. Vote GO/HOLD to advance in 10m.

kai: GO

samir: GO

marta: HOLD 5m more — want to validate under real traffic.

aria: Tally: 2 GO, 1 HOLD. extending to 15m total.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 2% by operator request.

(10m pass)

opsbot: telemetry stable: p95 +5ms, errors 0.02%.

aria: advancing to 10% in 30s. rollback thresholds: 5xx >0.5% sustained 5m or p95 jump >50ms -> auto-stop + pin to v2026.03.20.

marta: :thumbsup: EU should be pinned to previous if regression.

aria: region-specific fallback enabled. stepping up.

deploy-bot: advanced to 10% (step=3). Rolling into us-west + eu-central.

opsbot: early 10% look: eu-central p99 +40ms, p95 stable, errors unchanged.

samir: will watch; if p99 >150ms hold.

kai: ping infra for pod restarts (last rollout had node churn).

infra-bot: no pod churn observed in last 5m.

aria: consensus to continue to 50% after 30m soak? GO/HOLD (regional nuance allowed).

marta: HOLD until p99 in EU returns closer to baseline (15m soak).

samir: GO

kai: GO non-EU; EU HOLD until p99 <30ms delta.

aria: Decision: non-EU continue to 30% now; EU pinned at 10% pending p99 recovery within 20m. Documenting and updating release ticket. Action items: marta monitor EU p99, samir prep rollback playbook, eng-oncall standby.

deploy-bot: non-EU advanced to 30%, EU pinned at 10% (rollout_id=roll-8234). Logs: https://deploy.redwood/roll-8234

eng-oncall: dashboard: https://dash.redwood/serve-inference/roll-8234

aria: closing thread unless regression. Ping here for alerts.
